subject: Social Media
title: Facebook Knew
description: A short lesson to help you apply Facebook Knew.

hook.text: Internal Facebook research found Instagram made body image worse for 1 in 3 teen girls. They hid the data.

buildup.text: Whistleblower Frances Haugen leaked the documents in 2021. The findings were damning and specific.

discovery.text: Facebook's own researchers wrote: 'We make body image issues worse for one in three teen girls.' In writing.

twist.text: Despite knowing, Facebook proceeded with plans for a kids' version of Instagram. Profit overrode data.

climax.text: Congress hauled Zuckerberg to testify. He apologized to families of affected teens. Then changed nothing.

punchline.text: They had the data. They chose the money.

quiz.question: What did Facebook's internal research find about Instagram?
options: It worsened body image for 1 in 3 teen girls
It had no effect on mental health
